Delete your account: You can now permanently delete your HealthSync account from Settings. This removes all your cloud data — meals, hydration, workouts, and settings — and your login credentials, all in one step.
Clearer sign-out: Signing out now asks you to confirm and lets you choose to wipe every local entry on this device as part of the sign-out.
Smarter AI Detection: The AI buttons (Describe Food, Import Food, Capture Food, AI Detection) are now only enabled when your Gemini API key is configured and verified, so the menu never opens a broken flow.
AI options in the Quick Add menu and CalSync are visibly disabled when your API key is missing or invalid.
Invalid API keys are now rejected with a clear message instead of being saved silently.
Updated legal pages: The privacy policy has been refreshed (18 August 2026) with new sections covering the weather provider, reverse-geocoding service, support API, automated decisions, the supervisory authority, and a cookie inventory.
The cookie policy has been updated to match the simplified cookie preferences.
Simpler cookie preferences: The previous "Marketing" category has been removed. Analytics and ad-related data are denied by default, and only the Preferences and Third-Party categories now control what is shared.
Direct weather data: The dashboard weather widget now requests data from Open-Meteo directly, so the latest conditions load without going through any intermediary.
More reliable settings sync: Your macros and water goal are now correctly saved to the cloud — empty or invalid numbers no longer overwrite your existing values.
More accurate analytics: When you allow statistics cookies, your page views are now recorded correctly as you navigate the app — nothing is missed and no page is counted twice.
Security-related cookies always stay enabled regardless of your other cookie choices, so the app's core functions keep working reliably.
Drink history clear-all now syncs: Using "Clear all" on the hydration history now removes entries from both your local device and the cloud.
Better keyboard and screen-reader suppor: Charts, progress bars, dialogs, and toggle switches now expose proper labels so screen readers announce them correctly.
The drink picker is fully keyboard-navigable with the arrow keys.
Bottom sheets can now be closed with the Escape key.
Improved focus and contrast: Dim text on the dark theme is now easier to read, and form fields show a visible outline when focused with the keyboard.
Better error screens: If something goes wrong, you now see a clear message with a "Try again" button instead of a blank page.
Stronger account protection: Two-factor authentication is now always required when you sign in - it can no longer be skipped on a device.
Your synced data is now verified on the server before it is read or saved, ensuring only you can access it.
Pending food drafts: AI-detected foods now appear as pending drafts in your history with a clear indicator, so you can review and confirm them before they're saved.
AI detections are never lost: If you close the app while an AI food detection is still showing, your result is automatically saved and restored the next time you open CalSync — nothing gets lost.
Logging or dismissing the detection removes the saved result, so it never lingers behind the scenes.
Legal pages redesign: Privacy, Terms, Cookies, and AI Guidelines pages have been completely redesigned with better readability and colors that match your theme.
Updated supplements design: The supplements page has been redesigned for better usability and aesthetics, and visual issues have been removed.
Quick Add opens AI Detection: The "+" button on the dashboard now opens the AI Detection menu (photo, camera, or text description) instead of directly opening the food log.
Improved onboarding tour: The onboarding tour now highlights the AI Detection feature in the Quick Add menu.
Fixed AI tip display: Dashboard tips now show their icons correctly instead of raw text.
Faster sign-in: Signing in now takes you straight to your dashboard without extra page reloads.
Improved 2FA code entry: Entering your six-digit authenticator code is now more reliable, especially on mobile.
Fixed duplicate food entries from AI det: Fixed a bug where logging a food item via AI detection could create two identical entries instead of one.
Fixed deleting pending AI drafts: Fixed a bug where removing a pending AI detection draft would incorrectly remove other pending drafts that weren't selected.
Support page readability: Increased font size on the support page for better readability.
Updated weather provider: Weather information now comes from Open-Meteo for improved reliability.
AI text detection cleanup: Closing the "Describe Food" text input without analyzing now properly closes the modal instead of leaving "Analyzing..." visible.
Barcode scanner camera release: The camera now properly stops when closing the barcode scanner modal or switching away from the camera tab.
Barcode scanner console fix: Fixed continuous error messages in the background when the scanner is idle.

Updated changelog: The changelog has been updated to use a local JSON file for easier maintenance and to avoid issues with the Supabase backend.

Improved food detection: Food description analysis now works more reliably using your AI settings.

Better barcode scanning: The camera now automatically selects the best lens for scanning barcodes, making it faster and more reliable.
More reliable food logging: Improved validation prevents errors when saving food items with unusual nutrition data.
Improved update process: Updates now download and install more reliably, with clearer prompts.
Better barcode scanning reliability: The scanner now focuses properly on close-up barcodes instead of starting on the wide-angle lens.
Enhanced security and privacy: Improved security measures protect your data and prevent potential vulnerabilities.
Removed debug logging: Removed internal diagnostic logging that could accidentally capture user data.
Improved accessibility: Screen can now be zoomed in and out for better readability.
Removed non-functional button: Removed the non-working 'Switch Camera' button from the barcode scanner.
Updated documentation: Help documentation updated to reflect current app behavior.

Major update with many improvements: New exercises, better instructions, and various improvements across the app.
Improved update flow: Update process is now smoother with fewer prompts and better reliability.
Better workout tracking: Exercise tracking now shows both primary and secondary muscles worked.
Weather shows location names: Weather display now shows your location name instead of just coordinates.
More exercises available: Many new exercises have been added to the workout library.
Better exercise instructions: Each exercise now includes detailed step-by-step instructions and form tips.
Clearer muscle targeting: Workouts now clearly show which muscles are primarily worked and which are secondary.
Customizable privacy settings: You can now control which features use cookies and tracking in settings.
Added support page: You can now report bugs or ask questions directly from the app settings.
Redesigned workout interface: Workout browsing and exercise selection has been redesigned for easier use.
Faster and smoother performance: App launches quicker and animations run more smoothly.
Cleaner settings and interface: Settings menu and barcode scanner have been simplified and streamlined.
Fixed calorie tracker scrolling: Fixed an issue where the calorie tracking screen would scroll unexpectedly.
Added manual update option: You can now manually check for and install updates from the settings menu.
Various stability improvements: Fixed multiple issues affecting AI detection, API connections, menu styling, and more.

Update notifications in dashboard: You can now see update news and release notes directly from the dashboard refresh button.

Save favorite foods: You can now save your frequently used foods for quick access in a new modal.
Updated app logo: The app logo has been redesigned to better match the app's appearance and goals.
Workout break timer: You can now adjust rest periods between sets during workouts by adding or removing 15 seconds.
Personal record notifications: The app will now notify you when you lift more weight or do more reps than before.
Smoother screen transitions: Moving between screens now feels more fluid and responsive.
Better supplement tracking: Tracking your supplements is now more accurate and reliable.
Fixed data export: Fixed an issue where exported data wasn't properly formatted as CSV.
Fixed hydration tracking: Fixed a synchronization issue between server data and local storage for water tracking.

In-app update center: A new section in the app shows you the latest updates and what's new in each version.
New exercises with instructions: Many new exercises have been added, each with step-by-step instructions and tips.
Enhanced workout tracking: Workouts now track secondary muscles worked in addition to primary muscles.
Performance enhancements: Performance has been improved with various bug fixes and visual improvements.

Supplement Tracking: New feature to track your supplements including dosage and frequency.
Playwright Testing: Added automated testing via Playwright for better stability across the app.
Cookie Banner Update: The cookie banner no longer shows up once you have already accepted it.
Glass Animation: Added a smooth animation to the glass when using quick buttons.
Merged Download Button: CalSync and DropSync downloads are now combined into a single button.
AI Supplement Awareness: The AI now has access to supplement information for better recommendations.
Removed Copilot Instructions: Cleaned up unnecessary Copilot instruction files from the project.
Quick Button Fixes: Fixed issues with quick buttons on the dashboard and a missing hidden button when opening the drink modal.
Supabase Column Fix: Fixed intensity values being written to a non-existent column in Supabase.
Footer Content Fix: Fixed footer content not loading correctly.

PWA Update Banner: Added a banner to notify you about available updates for the PWA version of the app.
Current Weather Widget: Added a small weather widget to the dashboard showing current conditions for your location.
Activity Status: Added a status widget to the dashboard where you can track your current activity status (active, resting, injured). Supports date-specific entries and can be used to filter your health data.
Changelog Sync: You can now see the latest changes directly in the app. The changelog is synced with the GitHub repository.

Bug Fixes and Improvements: Fixed issues with AI detection for self-hosted LLMs, date handling, and language spelling errors.

Initial Release: HealthSync launches with CalSync for calorie tracking and DropSync for hydration tracking as its core features.

Initial HealthSync release: Dashboard with health score, macro and hydration tracking, food logging (CalSync), hydration tracking (DropSync), workouts, and multiple themes.
Weather widget and activity status tracking.
AI detection for food descriptions via a self-hosted LLM.
Supplement tracking, food favourites, workout break timer and PR tracking.
Legal pages (privacy, cookies, terms, AI guidelines).
Various fixes including CSV data export and cookie banner handling.
